tracks.genreDescription: 220 BPM thrash metal—razor-wire downpicking, nonstop double-bass drums, and a female fry scream sharp enough to strip paint off the bedroom walls.
tracks.lyrics:
**[Opening Scream]**  
Wake up! Wake up! Wake up! You’re such a piece of shit!  
If I had the time I’d kill you,  
but I gotta pick up my kids!

**[Verse]**  
Sunlight’s kicking holes through every cheap excuse,  
Your pillow’s got you hostage and your snooze is the abuse.  
The clock is eating minutes while you marinate in bed;  
Your rivals found the payroll—you found blankets for your head.

**[Gang Refrain]**  
Feet on the floor! Eyes open wide!  
Sleep makes nothing—get the fuck outside!  
Wake up! Stay up! Tear into the day!  
No one ever made a dime by dreaming it away!

**[Final Choke]**  
Get up. Get paid. Kids in the car.  
Now!

Your boss is drinking coffee, your competition’s dressed;  
You’re hugging polyester like it signs your checks.

**[Gang Chorus]**  
UP! UP! Get your ass awake!  
Time doesn’t refund every hour you waste!  
OUT! OUT! Throw the covers back!  
There’s no direct deposit in a pillowcase stack!

**[Breakdown]**  
Sleep had its turn.  
Comfort got paid.  
Now bite the morning  
before your whole damn future gets delayed.

**[Final Shout]**  
Five more minutes? Bullshit!
